title: Financial Information Return, Township of North Glengarry
publisher: Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing
notes: Provincially mandated, standardized across all Ontario municipalities and reported on the same schedules year over year. This is the backbone of the financial domain: it is the only multi-year series available without transcribing a stack of PDFs. Schedules 10 (revenue), 40 (expenses), 60 (continuity of reserves), 70 (long-term liabilities) and 80 (statistical) carry most of what this dashboard needs. URL and per-year files to be recorded in the source inventory audit.

title: Audited Consolidated Financial Statements, Township of North Glengarry
notes: Detail the Financial Information Return flattens: reserve fund purposes, tangible capital asset continuity, accumulated surplus composition, and the auditor's notes. Read alongside the FIR, never instead of it.

title: Approved Operating and Capital Budget, current year
notes: Approved figures. Pair with year-end actuals from the audited statements to produce budget-versus-actual variance.

title: Approved Operating and Capital Budgets, prior years
notes: Needed for the five-year approved-versus-actual series. Older budget books may only exist as agenda attachments.

title: Annual Tax Rate By-law
notes: Sets the rate for each property class. The township portion, the county portion, and the education portion are distinct — the dashboard must not present the township rate as the ratepayer's total.

title: Assessment roll summary by property class
notes: Assessment base by class. Current values reflect a valuation date that has been frozen by the province for several cycles; record the valuation date beside any assessment figure or the levy arithmetic will read wrong.

title: Asset Management Plan, Township of North Glengarry
notes: Anchor document for the infrastructure domain, required under O. Reg. 588/17. Carries the asset inventory, replacement values, condition distribution, stated levels of service, and the renewal funding gap. Confirm which regulatory phase the current plan satisfies and its adoption date.

title: Asset Management Plan technical appendices and supporting engineering reports
publisher: Township of North Glengarry / consulting engineers
notes: Where the per-asset detail lives. Usually a separate file from the plan itself and often not posted; request directly.

title: Roads needs study / pavement condition assessment
notes: Condition ratings and the methodology behind them. Record the assessment date: a condition rating without its date is not a fact about today.

title: Ontario Structure Inspection Manual (OSIM) bridge and culvert inspection reports
publisher: Township of North Glengarry / inspecting engineers
notes: OSIM inspections are required on a two-year cycle for structures with a span of three metres or more. County-owned structures are inspected and reported by the county; label the owner on every structure.

title: Drinking water system inspection ratings and annual compliance reports
publisher: Ontario Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks
notes: Provincial inspection ratings for each municipal residential drinking water system, plus the operator's annual and summary reports under O. Reg. 170/03. Systems are reported individually, not township-wide.

title: Wastewater treatment plant annual performance reports and bypass reporting
notes: Effluent quality against the Environmental Compliance Approval limits, plus overflow and bypass events. Reported per plant.

title: Water and wastewater rate study
notes: Establishes whether the water and wastewater systems are full-cost recovering, and what the rate path assumes about renewal.

title: Official Plan
publisher: Township of North Glengarry / United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
notes: Confirm which plan governs. In several SDG member municipalities the county official plan is the operative document and the local plan is subordinate or absent. This determines who approves what, and the dashboard must state it correctly.

title: Comprehensive Zoning By-law
notes: Zoning is a township instrument. Amendments are township decisions, appealable to the Ontario Land Tribunal.

title: Planning staff reports and decision records
notes: Application-by-application record: type, date received, date decided, recommendation, decision, conditions. Processing timelines have to be built from these; no municipality of this size publishes them as a series.

title: Strategic Plan
notes: Council's stated priorities and, where they exist, the measures attached to them. Record whether each priority carries a measure — many strategic plans state direction without one, and that absence is itself a finding.

title: Council agendas, minutes, and staff reports
notes: The connective tissue. Every decision recorded in the council domain cites the meeting date and the report number. Personal information contained in these packages is excluded from the dashboard.

title: United Counties of SDG council agendas, minutes, and budget documents
publisher: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
notes: County-owned roads, paramedic services, social services, long-term care, and county planning approvals are decided here, not at the township. Township council members sit on county council.

title: United Counties of SDG approved budget and levy apportionment
publisher: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
notes: The county levy appears on the North Glengarry ratepayer's bill but is not set by township council. Apportionment among member municipalities is weighted by assessment.

title: Census of Population, 2021 — North Glengarry, Township (census subdivision)
notes: Census subdivision boundaries align with the municipal boundary; smaller geographies such as dissemination areas do not, and labour force data at fine geography carries wide error. State the geography on every community figure.

title: Census of Population, 2016 and earlier — North Glengarry, Township
notes: Needed for multi-census trend. Definitions change between cycles; note any break in series rather than smoothing it.

title: Census of Agriculture — North Glengarry
notes: Farm counts, farm area, farm type, and operator age. Agriculture is the dominant land use in the township and this is the only consistent series on it.

title: Building permit register and Chief Building Official annual report
notes: Permit counts and declared construction value by type. Construction value is the applicant's declared value for fee purposes and is not a market or assessed value; say so wherever it appears.

title: Fire department annual report
notes: Incident counts by type, roster, apparatus, and training. Confirm whether response time is reported, and if so, measured from what event to what event.

title: Ontario Fire Marshal incident and fire loss statistics
publisher: Office of the Fire Marshal, Ontario
notes: Standardized incident reporting. Provincial aggregates are published with a lag and small-municipality cells may be suppressed.

title: Fire master plan / community risk assessment
notes: O. Reg. 378/18 requires a community risk assessment to be completed and reviewed on a fixed cycle. It states the service model and the depth of response the township has chosen, which is the only fair benchmark for response performance.

title: Policing service record: contract or provincial billing statement, and detachment statistics
publisher: Ontario Provincial Police / Township of North Glengarry
notes: Confirm the service model and record the annual cost and its per-property basis. Detachment-level statistics cover a service area that may not match the township boundary; label the geography.

title: Emergency response plan and annual compliance filing
notes: The Emergency Management and Civil Protection Act requires an adopted plan, an annual exercise, and annual training. Compliance is filed with the province; currency of the plan is checkable.

title: Recreation and facilities reports: registrations, facility usage, rental revenue
notes: Rarely published as a series. Likely to require manual entry from budget presentations and individual staff reports.

title: Public library annual report and Ontario Public Library Statistics submission
publisher: North Glengarry Public Library / Ontario Ministry of Tourism, Culture and Sport
notes: The provincial statistics submission is standardized across Ontario libraries and multi-year, which makes it more useful than the local annual report for trend.

title: Grant agreements and transfer payment records: OCIF, ICIP, Canada Community-Building Fund, OMPF
publisher: Government of Ontario / Government of Canada
notes: The Ontario Municipal Partnership Fund allocation and the Canada Community-Building Fund allocation are formula-driven and announced annually. Project-specific grants are episodic and have to be gathered from council reports.

title: Development charges background study and by-law
notes: Confirm whether the township has a development charges by-law at all. Many rural Ontario townships do not, which changes who pays for growth-related infrastructure. The absence is a finding, not a gap.

title: Ontario Land Tribunal decisions affecting North Glengarry
notes: Appeal history for planning decisions. Searchable by municipality.

title: Raisin Region Conservation Authority reports and regulated area mapping
notes: Regulated areas constrain development independently of township zoning. Confirm which conservation authority or authorities have jurisdiction over which parts of the township — boundaries follow watersheds, not municipal lines.

title: United Counties of SDG transportation master plan and county road inventory
publisher: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
notes: County roads running through the township are county assets, maintained and rebuilt on the county's capital plan. Residents do not distinguish them from township roads; the dashboard must.

title: SDG Paramedic Services annual report and response time standard
publisher: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
notes: Land ambulance is an upper-tier responsibility. Council-adopted response time standards are published annually under provincial regulation.

title: SDG social services, housing, and child care service manager reports
publisher: United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry
notes: The county is the consolidated municipal service manager. Social housing waitlists and child care capacity are county-reported and cover all member municipalities; township-level splits may not exist.

title: Municipal Study (BMA) financial indicators, if the township participates
notes: Comparator context across Ontario municipalities on a consistent basis. Participation is voluntary and the report is licensed; confirm whether the township or the county subscribes before relying on it.

title: Financial Information Returns for comparator municipalities
publisher: Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing
notes: Comparator set is not yet chosen — see the open question on which municipalities the sponsor considers fair. Candidates would be lower-tier Eastern Ontario townships of similar population, assessment base, and road kilometres. Any comparison is context, not judgement.
